io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.volume

Class BaseVolumeRequest

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.volume.BaseVolumeRequest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    ApplyVolumeRequest

    public class BaseVolumeRequest
extends Object
implements Serializable
    Base request class for volume operations.

    Holds the API key and additional options shared by volume requests. The API key needs to be filled in when calling the cloud API.
